label: Is in equilibrium
summary: Whether the progress bar is in equilibrium (true or false).
details: Going by its name and its use in the shared progress bar GUI files, where it decides whether a piece of the bar is visible. The game does not say what counts as equilibrium.

label: Is increasing
summary: Whether the progress bar's value is going up (true or false).
details: Going by its name and its use in the shared progress bar GUI files, where it is the visibility condition of several parts of the bar.

label: The bar itself
summary: The complex progress bar itself, as a value that can be handed to other functions.
details: The game's own GUI lines pass `Self` of a type to other functions (for example `ComplexBar.GetIndexOfItem( ComplexBarItem.Self )` in the accolade window). Vanilla has no line using it on this type, so this rests on the name.

label: The bar item itself
summary: One part (item) of a complex progress bar, as the item itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the item over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Item index
summary: The position number of this item within its progress bar, as a whole number.
details: Going by its name, it is the item's position in its bar. Vanilla uses it in the merit progress bar's marker tooltip, to look up that marker's level name and the threshold it requires.

label: Marker level
summary: A whole number: the level of this bar item's marker.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Item value
summary: The number this bar item stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it in the diarchy window, where the value is passed to checks such as whether it is the current power level, or whether the level for a swing is above zero.

label: Item width
summary: A whole number saying how wide this item is within its progress bar.
details: Vanilla feeds it into the stretch factor of the bar's layout (horizontal and vertical bars). Going by that use, it is the item's share of the bar, not a pixel size.

label: Is visible
summary: Whether this item of the progress bar should be shown (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility condition of the item's widget in the shared progress bars and in the diarchy window.

label: The bar item itself
summary: This progress bar item itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Vanilla uses it in the accolade window, handing the item to `ComplexBar.GetIndexOfItem` to find its position, which then picks a rank icon and tooltip.

label: Concubine info itself
summary: The concubine information object itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the object over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Base offer
summary: The base offer of the concubine arrangement, as an object the interface can show details of.
details: Vanilla uses it in the concubine interaction window as the data context of a part of the window. The game does not describe what the offer holds.

label: Concubine info itself
summary: The concubine information object itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Going by its name. Other types use `Self` this way (for example `DynastyHouse.Self` as an argument), but vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Concubine window itself
summary: The concubine interaction window itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the window over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Can clear
summary: Whether the concubine interaction window can be cleared (true or false).

label: Base window

label: Concubine info
summary: The concubine information object of this window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the concubine interaction window.

label: Prompt text

label: Concubine window itself

fields.text: The name of the custom text to produce.

label: Cohesion

label: Cohesion change per month
summary: How much the confederation's cohesion changes each month, as a number that can be positive or negative.
details: Vanilla shows it in the confederation window with an explicit plus or minus sign, followed by '/month'.

label: Cohesion level
summary: The cohesion level the confederation is currently at, as an object the interface can read details from.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the confederation window. Its name text is available separately through the cohesion level name function.

summary: The name of the confederation's current cohesion level, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the confederation window after the words 'Cohesion Level'.

label: Cohesion per house

label: Combined military strength
summary: The combined military strength of the confederation, as a number.

label: Coat of arms
summary: The confederation's coat of arms.
details: It leads on to a coat of arms object. Vanilla chains it with `GetTexture` and `GetSlot` (both at size 56 by 56) to draw the coat of arms in the HUD and in shared coat of arms widgets.

label: Confederation tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that describes the confederation.
details: Vanilla uses it as the text of the shared tooltip widget.

label: Confederation ID

details: Vanilla only counts the list, to show the number of individual rulers in the confederation window.

label: Leading house
summary: The house that leads the confederation.
details: It leads on to a dynasty house, so its name or `Self` can be read from it. Vanilla uses it in the confederation window for the leader's name and as that part's data context, and in the house window to compare the leader with the house shown.

label: Member count
summary: How many members the confederation has, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in confederation tooltips, labelled as confederates and, for a bloc, as member houses.

label: Member houses
summary: The list of houses that are members of the confederation.
details: Vanilla only counts the list, to show the number of member houses in the confederation window.

label: Members
summary: The list of all rulers who are members of the confederation.
details: Vanilla only counts the list, to show the total number of rulers in the confederation window.

label: Confederation name
summary: The confederation's name, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as the window header and in tooltips.

label: Confederation type
summary: The kind of confederation this is.
details: It leads on to a confederation type, so its name or its house-based check can be read from it. Vanilla shows the type name in the window and uses the house-based check to show or hide HUD parts.

label: Has cohesion
summary: Whether the confederation has cohesion (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility condition of several parts of the confederation window. Going by its name, those are the cohesion parts.

label: Has leading house
summary: Whether the confederation has a leading house (true or false).
details: Vanilla combines it with the house-based check of the confederation type to decide whether to show a part of the confederation window.

label: Is hovered
summary: Whether the mouse pointer is over the confederation (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility condition of a part of the shared coat of arms GUI. Going by its name, that part is shown while the pointer is over the confederation.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether the confederation is currently selected (true or false).
details: Vanilla has no line using it on this type. Other types have a function of the same name used for the pressed state of list entries, which is only a hint.

label: Exists
summary: Whether there is a confederation here (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it as a check before showing confederation parts of the HUD, the house window and coat of arms widgets, so they are hidden when there is none.

label: Make scope
summary: Turns the confederation into a script scope (a game object that scripted effects and triggers can work on).
details: Vanilla uses it when a watch window is added for the confederation in the confederation window.

label: Mouse enters
summary: Tells the game that the mouse pointer has entered the confederation's icon.
details: It returns nothing; it is an action. Vanilla runs it as the start action of the confederation's map icon, next to the matching mouse-leave function. Going by its name, it tells the game the icon is hovered.

label: Mouse leaves
summary: Tells the game that the mouse pointer has left the confederation's icon.
details: It returns nothing; it is an action. Vanilla runs it as the start action of the confederation's map icon, right after the mouse-enter function.

label: Confederation itself
summary: The confederation itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Vanilla uses it when opening the confederation window, passing the confederation as the data for the window.

label: Confederation icon itself
summary: The confederation's map icon itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the icon over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Confederation
summary: The confederation that this map icon stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context in the map icon layer, so the icon's parts can read from the confederation.

label: Confederation icon itself
summary: The confederation's map icon itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Going by its name. Other types use `Self` this way, but vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Confederation type itself
summary: The confederation type itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the type over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Custom text
summary: A piece of text about the confederation type, picked by a name given in quotes.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom text to produce.

summary: The list of levels that this confederation type has.
details: Vanilla uses it in the confederation window both as the list to fill from, and, through its size, to decide how many level entries to show.

label: Confederation type name

details: Vanilla uses it in the names of a confederation's cohesion modifiers: 'Leading [type] - level', 'Aligned to [type] - level', 'Divergent to [type] - level'.

label: Type name without tooltip
summary: The name of the confederation type, as text, without the hover tooltip.
details: Going by its name and the same function on provinces, where the 'no tooltip' form gives plain text. Vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Is house-based
summary: Whether this confederation type is house-based, that is, built on member houses (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it in the confederation window and HUD to show one set of parts for house-based confederations and another set for the others. The game does not describe it further.

label: Make scope
summary: Turns the confederation type into a script scope.
details: Going by its name and the same function on other types. Vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Confederation type itself
summary: The confederation type itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Going by its name. Other types use `Self` this way, but vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Member list
summary: The member list of the confederation window, as an object the interface can use.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the confederation window.

label: Confederation window itself
summary: The confederation window itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the window over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

details: It returns nothing; it is an action. Vanilla runs it when the mouse leaves a part of the confederation window, where the matching set-hovered-house action runs on entering.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the confederation window.

label: Hovered house cohesion tooltip
summary: The tooltip content about how much cohesion the house under the mouse gives the confederation.

label: Combined strength tooltip
summary: The tooltip text explaining the combined military strength of the confederation.
details: Vanilla builds a localization text out of it for the confederation window.

label: Confederation
summary: The confederation that the window is showing.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the window, so the rest of the window reads from that confederation.

label: Current combined strength
summary: The confederation's current combined military strength, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text and as the current value of a progress bar in the window; the matching maximum comes from the max function.

label: House military strength tooltip
summary: The tooltip text explaining the military strength of the given house in the confederation window.
details: Vanilla builds a localization text out of it, passing the house being listed.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The house whose military strength is explained.

label: Maximum combined strength
summary: The highest combined military strength that the window's bar can show, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the maximum of a progress bar, and shows the bar only when it is not zero.

label: Member houses
summary: The list of member houses that the confederation window lists.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list to fill one part of the window from, one entry per house.

label: Progress bar
summary: The progress bar object of the confederation window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the bar widget. The game does not describe what the bar shows.

label: Monthly cohesion tooltip
summary: The tooltip content for the total monthly cohesion change.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a tooltip part in the confederation window.

label: Is house hovered

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The house to check.

label: Is player's confederation
summary: Whether the confederation shown is the player's own (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it to show some window parts only for the player's confederation.

label: Is player house the head
summary: Whether the player's house is the head of the confederation (true or false).
details: Going by its name. Vanilla uses it with the hovered-house check and the interaction checks that show the kick-from-bloc and grant-leadership buttons.

label: Confederation window itself
summary: The confederation window itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Going by its name. Other types use `Self` this way, but vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Set hovered house
summary: Remembers the given house as the one the mouse is over in the confederation window.
details: It returns nothing; it is an action. Vanilla runs it when the mouse enters a house entry in the confederation window, and the clear function runs when the mouse leaves.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The house to remember as hovered.

details: Vanilla shows it as a text in the council task window, passing the player.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character it is described for.

label: Position name
summary: The name of the council position, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in council texts, for example 'No ... selected' and '... can be appointed as ...'.

label: Position name for player
summary: The name of the council position as it is shown to the player, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in the title 'Appoint a ...' of the potential councillor window. How it differs from the plain name is not stated.

label: Portrait animation
summary: The name of the portrait animation used for a councillor in this position, as text.
details: Vanilla passes it to the animated character portrait in the council scene, together with the council environment and camera.

label: Position tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the council position.
details: Going by its name and the same function on other types, which give hover text. Vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Council position itself
summary: The council position type itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Vanilla uses it in the council task window, passing the position to `GetSkillItemForPosition`.

label: Task asset itself
summary: The council task asset itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the asset over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Task background
summary: The background image of a council task.
details: Going by vanilla's use of the same chain `GetTaskAsset.GetTaskBackground` on a potential task in the shared buttons GUI, where it is a button texture.

label: Task frame
summary: The frame image of a council task.
details: Going by vanilla's use of the same chain `GetTaskAsset.GetTaskFrame` on a potential task in the shared buttons GUI, where it is a button texture.

label: Task glow
summary: The glow image of a council task.
details: Going by vanilla's use of the same chain `GetTaskAsset.GetTaskGlow` on a potential task in the council window, where it is a texture.

label: Task icon
summary: The icon image of a council task.
details: Going by vanilla's use of the same chain `GetTaskAsset.GetTaskIcon` on potential and active tasks, in the council window and on the map, where it is a texture.

label: Task asset itself
summary: The council task asset itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Going by its name. Other types use `Self` this way, but vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Task item itself
summary: The council task interaction item itself.
details: Going by its name, it hands the item over so another function can use it. Vanilla does not use it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Active council task
summary: The active council task that this entry stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the council task interaction window.

label: Main skill item
summary: The main skill entry of the council task item.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla has no line using it on this type; the council window uses a function of the same name on a council position as a data context, which is only a hint.

label: Skill items
summary: The list of skill entries of the council task item.
details: Going by its name. Vanilla has no line using it on this type; other windows use a function of the same name on character list entries as a list to fill from, which is only a hint.

label: Select item
summary: Selects this council task item.
details: It returns nothing; it is an action. Vanilla runs it when an entry of the council task interaction window is clicked.

label: Task item itself
summary: The council task interaction item itself, as a value that can be passed to other functions.
details: Going by its name. Other types use `Self` this way, but vanilla has no line using it on this type.

label: Council positions
summary: The list of council positions that the council task interaction window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list that the window's position entries are filled from.
